disclosure.plan: BENCHMARK_PLAN.md §2 disclosure, §3 scenarios, §4 metrics, §5 bias controls
eqproxy_help: ExyonQ Proxy (EQProxy): reverse proxy and load balancer
haproxy_vv: Status: long-term supported branch - will stop receiving fixes around Q2 2031.
Running on: Linux 6.17.0-1018-oracle #18~24.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Mon Jun 22 18:23:57 UTC 2026 aarch64
OPTIONS = USE_PTHREAD_EMULATION=1 USE_GETADDRINFO=1 USE_OPENSSL=1 USE_LUA=1 USE_QUIC=1 USE_PROMEX=1 USE_PCRE2=1 USE_PCRE2_JIT=1
disclosure.topology: one Linux host; backends + both proxies as containers on one bridge network; oha on the host against published proxy ports (same as the v0.5 canonical runs).
disclosure.origin_headroom: origins run BACKEND_WORKERS=8 SO_REUSEPORT Python workers so the origin does not saturate under oha -c 50 (the measured component is the proxy); health checks are production-tolerant and symmetric (inter 2s, timeout 5s, fall 3, rise 2 in both products).

generator.request: GET with Host = host:port of the proxy port; S-H1-04 hits GET /bench/last, S-H1-05 GET /
generator.correction: --latency-correction ON (coordinated-omission corrected). The v0.5 phase2c runs did not use it: cross-campaign latency comparison is invalid by design.

disclosure.duration_per_rep: 10s measured (oha), plus one identical discarded warm-up per run

scenario_interpretation.S-H1-04: 10 listeners (web + l2..l10), 100 backends (api, mgmt, b3..b100) each with an HTTP health check every 2s; 20 rules on the measured listener (r01..r19 miss on host/path/method/header, r20 matches /bench/ and rewrites to /api/ + header actions). Load flows only through the `web` listener; the other 9 listeners bind their ports and health-check their backends (config realism, no bench traffic).
scenario_interpretation.S-H1-05: 1 listener + 1 backend with 500 origin servers (HTTP health check every 2s each), round-robin over all 500. oha -c 50 keep-alive: ~50 servers serve live traffic while all 500 are health-checked continuously (the scenario's point).

metrics.e2e_latency: oha latencyPercentiles (p50/p95/p99, end-to-end at the generator), CO-corrected
metrics.cpu_pct_one_core: Delta(utime+stime)/CLK_TCK summed over all container processes / wall time x 100 (100 = one core; haproxy 3.x runs master-worker, so PID 1 alone would read 0)
metrics.rss_bytes: summed VmRSS of all container processes right after the run; hwm_bytes = summed per-process VmHWM (upper bound of the total peak)

  mode http
  option httplog

  timeout check 5s
  timeout connect 5s
  timeout client 60s
  timeout server 60s
  timeout http-request 5s
